what.text: This page follows refugees from Moldova living in Germany, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 1998 Moldovan refugees in Germany, 34.2% of all refugees from Moldova.
Germany is the largest host of Moldovan refugees, followed by the United States, France and Romania.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict and no dated events for Moldova, so it does not say why people left.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2002 to 2005 and 2007 to 2012.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2002 at 5370 refugees.
The figure was at its highest, 5641, at the end of 2003; it fell to a low in 2013 and then rose.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Germany.
These are year-end totals for Germany only, reported to UNHCR.
